cases.nl: 按观看日期和渠道分组，统计 IndiaA 渠道在 2026-08-19 至 2026-08-25、指定影片类型为电影电视剧真人秀短剧动漫肥皂剧、四种内容语言的人均观看时长
goldSqls:
SELECT toDate(lastWatchTime) AS watchDate, channel,
round(sumIf(watchSecond, contentLang='') / uniqIf(guid, contentLang=''), 0) AS a,
round(sumIf(watchSecond, contentLang='te-IN') / uniqIf(guid, contentLang='te-IN'), 0) AS b,
round(sumIf(watchSecond, contentLang='ta-IN') / uniqIf(guid, contentLang='ta-IN'), 0) AS c,
round(sumIf(watchSecond, contentLang='ml-IN') / uniqIf(guid, contentLang='ml-IN'), 0) AS d
FROM elt_watch_detail
WHERE toDate(lastWatchTime) BETWEEN '2026-08-19' AND '2026-08-25'
  AND channel IN ('IndiaA')
  AND movieType IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 10, 11)
GROUP BY watchDate, channel
ORDER BY watchDate, channel
cases.reviewNote: gold aligned with verified-queries.watch_avg_per_user_lang_wide; per-value wide (4 lang columns), not 2 SQLs

cases.nl: IndiaA 在 2026-08-19 至 2026-08-25 按语言宽表完播率
goldSqls:
SELECT watchDate, channel,
round(sumIf(a, contentLang='') / countIf(contentLang=''), 0) AS aa,
round(sumIf(a, contentLang='te-IN') / countIf(contentLang='te-IN'), 0) AS bb,
round(sumIf(a, contentLang='ta-IN') / countIf(contentLang='ta-IN'), 0) AS cc,
round(sumIf(a, contentLang='ml-IN') / countIf(contentLang='ml-IN'), 0) AS dd
FROM (
  SELECT toDate(lastWatchTime) AS watchDate, channel, eid, contentLang, max(maxWatchProgress) AS a
  FROM elt_watch_detail
  WHERE toDate(lastWatchTime) BETWEEN '2026-08-19' AND '2026-08-25'
    AND channel IN ('IndiaA')
    AND movieType IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 10, 11)
  GROUP BY watchDate, channel, guid, eid, contentLang
)
GROUP BY watchDate, channel
ORDER BY watchDate, channel

goldSqls:
SELECT
  round(a / total, 6) AS a2,
  round(b / total, 6) AS b2,
  round(c / total, 6) AS c2,
  round(d / total, 6) AS d2
FROM (
  SELECT 1 AS i1, count() AS total
  FROM elt_film_user
  WHERE channel = 'IndiaA' AND appVersion = '2.4.1'
) t1
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT 1 AS i,
    uniqIf(uid, contentLang='') AS a,
    uniqIf(uid, contentLang='te-IN') AS b,
    uniqIf(uid, contentLang='ta-IN') AS c,
    uniqIf(uid, contentLang='ml-IN') AS d
  FROM elt_film_user AS aa
  INNER JOIN elt_film_order AS bb ON aa._id = bb.uid
  WHERE toDate(bb.createdTime) BETWEEN '2026-08-19' AND '2026-08-25'
    AND bb.orderStatus = 6
    AND bb.channelName = 'IndiaA'
    AND aa.appVersion = '2.4.1'
    AND bb.appVersion = '2.4.1'
) t2 ON t1.i1 = t2.i
cases.reviewNote: gold aligned with verified-queries.pay_rate_lang_wide

cases.nl: IndiaA 版本 2.4.1 在 2026-08-19 次日留存按语言
goldSqls:
WITH
'IndiaA' AS targetChannel,
toDate('2026-08-19') AS targetDate,
todayGuid AS (
  SELECT guid, argMax(contentLang, createTime) AS contentLang
  FROM gather.gather
  WHERE eventName = 'content_language_save_success'
    AND toDate(createTime) = targetDate
    AND channel = targetChannel
    AND appVerName = '2.4.1'
    AND guid IN (SELECT DISTINCT guid FROM elt_new_guid WHERE createDate = targetDate AND channel = targetChannel)
  GROUP BY guid
),
retentionGuid AS (
  SELECT b.guid, b.contentLang
  FROM elt_active_guid AS a
  INNER JOIN todayGuid AS b ON a.guid = b.guid
  WHERE a.activeDate = addDays(targetDate, 1) AND a.channel = targetChannel
),
todayCount AS (
  SELECT countIf(contentLang='') AS a, countIf(contentLang='te-IN') AS b, countIf(contentLang='ta-IN') AS c, countIf(contentLang='ml-IN') AS d
  FROM todayGuid
),
retentionCount AS (
  SELECT countIf(contentLang='') AS aa, countIf(contentLang='te-IN') AS bb, countIf(contentLang='ta-IN') AS cc, countIf(contentLang='ml-IN') AS dd
  FROM retentionGuid
)
SELECT t1.a, t1.b, t1.c, t1.d, t2.aa, t2.bb, t2.cc, t2.dd,
  round(t2.aa / t1.a, 2), round(t2.bb / t1.b, 2), round(t2.cc / t1.c, 2), round(t2.dd / t1.d, 2)
FROM todayCount AS t1, retentionCount AS t2
cases.reviewNote: gold aligned with verified-queries.retention_d1_lang
